reasons.plausibility: Inducing L10-like precipitates to enhance anisotropy and coercivity in FeCoNi is scientifically credible but hinges on achieving stable ordered domains in this alloy.
reasons.testability: The proposed annealing experiment and subsequent microstructural plus magnetic characterization provide a clear and decisive test.
reasons.usefulness: If verified, the method offers a straightforward route to increase coercivity while preserving high magnetization, directly addressing the stated research problem.
